hooks.command: read -r input; fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); if echo "$fp" | grep -q '/docs/'; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"SYNC REMINDER: A docs file was updated ($fp) — check if CLAUDE.md needs to be updated to reflect this change.\"}}"; fi
